verdict.rationale: Retell's own Conductor assistant lets users operate the product in plain language across many surfaces. It can build and refine agents, investigate call and chat history, build analytics dashboards, inspect AI QA, knowledge bases and contacts, and run simulation tests, with proposed changes reviewed before applying. An official MCP server also lets MCP clients such as Claude and Cursor manage agents conversationally. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Conductor's natural-language operation, and evidence of how reliably it handles complex or multi-step commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Conductor is Retell's AI assistant for building agents, investigating conversations, and improving analytics dashboards. Ask for what you need in plain language, attach relevant context, and review proposed changes before applying them.
Ask Conductor to change your agent's prompts, settings, or conversation flow in plain language. It proposes edits for you to review before applying them.
click **Generate from prompt** (marked Suggested) to let [Conductor](/conductor/create-agent) draft an agent from a plain-English description of your use case
Ask Conductor to build an analytics dashboard or improve one you already use. Describe what you want to measure, then review its proposed changes before applying them.
Retell supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) so you can build Retell AI voice agents directly from MCP-capable clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex-style tools, and more).
